title: Lantern Rooftops
brief: A cozy 2D platformer: a lamplighter hops across rooftops lighting lanterns while owls swoop. Track progress in GameState: count jumps in jumps, lanterns lit in lanterns_lit, owl hits in hits_taken, and set won to true at the chimney once every lantern is lit. A hit knocks the player back and the chimney only opens after the last lantern is lit.
artDirection: Warm lantern glow against a deep blue night, chunky readable pixel art, owls and ladders clearly silhouetted.

obligations.description: Pressing jump makes the player jump at least once.
Touching a lantern raises the lit count.
An owl collision counts a hit against the player.
Reaching the chimney after lighting the lanterns wins the level.
